name: Winterfall Village
summary: In Winterfall Village, furbolgs have turned against travelers east of Everlook. Once peaceful kin to Kalimdor’s other ursine tribes, they now live in madness and violent corruption under High Chief Winterfall.

sections.title: A Tribe Consumed
sections.body:
Snowy terraces east of Everlook hold Winterfall Village, the main settlement of the Winterfall furbolgs in Winterspring. Like their cousins across northern Kalimdor, these bear-folk were warped and driven mad by the foulness left by the Burning Legion’s invasion.

High Chief Winterfall leads the tribe from a secluded cavern atop the village’s highest tier. The furbolgs have abandoned their ancestral communion with the wild spirits of the snow. Now they assault travelers, patrol the mountain passes, and threaten anyone who comes near their frost-bitten home.

faq.answer: On snowy slopes east of Everlook in Winterspring, Winterfall Village is the main settlement of the Winterfall furbolgs.

faq.q: Why are the furbolgs here hostile?
faq.answer: The Burning Legion’s lingering demonic taint warped the Winterfall furbolgs’ minds and drove them from peaceful customs to hostility toward outsiders after the Third War.
High Chief Winterfall leads the tribe from a small cave at the settlement’s highest point.

faq.q: Why does Everlook care about this village?
faq.answer: Winterfall Village lies close to Everlook. Its furbolgs raid passing caravans, disrupt trade routes, and threaten the goblins’ mining and mercantile interests in eastern Winterspring.

angles.text: As a druid, you may mourn the Winterfall tribe’s corruption. Furbolgs were ancient allies of the night elves and the Cenarion Circle before demonic madness took hold.
As a night elf, you may feel the Winterfall tribe’s fall as another painful break in the ancient bonds between your people and Kalimdor’s native peoples.
